Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers must check every companion animal travel detail before arrival, so the process stays calm and safe for everyone. Please keep documents ready, follow staff directions, and use gentle handling at the desk and in the waiting area.

Handlers will use calm, humane methods around animals, and we ask travelers to share any concern promptly and respectfully. If a pet shows stress, give space, speak softly, and allow the team to guide the next step. <<FACT F077>> Please do not bring any item or carrier that could unsettle the animal, and keep identification secure and visible.

Aurelia Skyways values clear communication, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk will give concise guidance that supports a smooth check-in. If your plans change, tell the desk as soon as possible so the team can help without delay. Your cooperation helps protect animal welfare and keeps travel orderly for all guests.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
